origin.audience: South African independent-school academic leaders, assessment coordinators and educators
origin.cta: Review the tight-eight proof and request one subject-and-grade pilot.

units.source_text: One curriculum spine should not produce eight identical-looking papers. Watch HOMS change the assessment architecture with the subject.

Eight Grade 12 Term 3 subject packs with separate memoranda, source-grounded papers, embedded media and educator approval boundaries.

If ISASA is shown 'Cross-phase live proof: Grade 3 Mathematics activity-style pack vs Grade 10 Dance Studies performance task, each with memo/rubric and educator approval.', then the Academic/curriculum decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

Call to action: Review the tight-eight proof and request one subject-and-grade pilot.
